The '''Prison Geothermal Collectors''' were a part of the Republic's detention complex located in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. The collectors powered the surveillance network in the area, and though Field [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Anhur]] led security forces in defending the installation, Imperials overran the collectors and destroyed them.
